about: Two-finger touchpad swipes on Windows (windows/src/Swipe.cs, feature win.swipe): a burst of scroll messages, each [t ms, horizontal delta (+ scrolls right), vertical delta], gives at most one action. Scrolling left is back, right is options; 300 units across, at least twice the travel up or down; a 250 ms pause ends the burst. Windows only: the phone's swipes go to the previous or next story (phone.swipe), so only windows/tests/Tests.cs reads this file.

bursts.name: fingers right to left (scroll left): back
fingers left to right (scroll right): options
coasting after the fingers lift stays one swipe
two swipes with a pause between: two actions
pauses longer than 250 ms split small pieces that never add up
a diagonal page scroll is not a swipe
mostly across with a little down still counts
scrolling down first, then sideways in the same burst, waits until across is twice the down
held tilt wheel clicks: one action
the tick count wrapping past int's top doesn't break a burst
